overall: The AG found the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by omitting the separation agreement terms from its February 27 executive session minutes, declined the release complaint as moot, and ordered compliance and minutes revision.

allegations.summary: June complaint: the Board kept February 27 executive session minutes sealed after the purpose for nondisclosure had passed.
allegations.key_passage: Because the Board has now released those executive session minutes and provided them to Mr. Dumont, we decline to review this complaint.

allegations.summary: August complaint: the February 27 executive session minutes were a vague summary and omitted the terms of the proposed separation agreement.
allegations.key_passage: Thus, the Board failed to include in its minutes a sufficient summary of the discussion on this subject.

allegations.summary: August complaint: the minutes did not detail the nature of the complaints against the Interim Town Administrator or who made them.
allegations.key_passage: we find that the Board did not actually discuss the complaints but rather Town Legal Counsel provided a summary of the allegations to the Board, and therefore the minutes include the minimum that the Open Meeting Law requires.

allegations.summary: Not raised in the complaint: the Board discussed separation agreement terms in executive session under Purpose 1 (complaints), which the AG found was outside that purpose.
allegations.key_passage: This discussion was not appropriate under Purpose 1.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law (G.L. c. 30A, §§ 18-25).
Revise the February 27 executive session minutes to reflect the terms the Board discussed regarding the separation agreement, within 30 days of receipt of the letter.
remedy_passage: We order the Board's immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, and we caution that similar future violations may be considered evidence of intent to violate the law. We further order the Board to revise its February 27 executive session minutes to reflect the terms that the Board discussed with respect to the separation agreement within thirty (30) days from receipt of this letter.
